episodes.title: This Cult Documented Their Crimes (in a kids show!)
episodes.description:
Want to be scarred by a creepy puppet show? This cult made their own kids show, and in so doing, did a lot of telling on themselves, revealing quite a look behind the puppet curtain into the dark truth hiding in plain sight underneath. The Family International, The Family, Children of God, this cult went by many names, but no matter what you call it, it was definitely creepy. 

Watch along with us as we get to the bottom of the mysteries presented in this puppet kids show: Life With Grandpa. For example, why is it "grandpa and mommy's room"? What in the uncle baby billy is going on there? 

Also, this creepy cult VHS is also chock full of fun songs, especially the one about the scientist. That song is a banger, and I commissioned a vapor wave cover, stay tuned to the end for the world premiere of the first ever music video based on a cult robot...love...song. I think it has to be the first, right? 

There is another part coming (this is part 3 of 4), support on Patreon and you can watch part 4 RIGHT NOW: https://www.patreon.com/xplodeon

Part 1, Little Marcy: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3PUSILOTNb0
Part 2, Joy Junction (aka, the puppet true crime): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dCSS7VJjajs

Dark, twisted, creepy, horrifying stuff about predators and creepy church stuff, it's an Xplodeon Explose as we try to figure out flirty fishing and so much more. 

Some Music by Karl Casey @White Bat Audio

We previously made an episode about several other Christian kids shows, it's a 90 minute thrill ride about men with mustaches: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-BPds8v9YXE

Also discussed: Duck lips, bridal theology, puppet cameramen, a puppet reporter, featuring Donny Cilantro.

With thanks and some clips from  @NickCrowley​
